result.eventDescription: One delivered nonempty PDF page: $10 per 1,000 rows. Row keys page, total_pages, source_url, extraction, markdown, characters, width. No start fee; compute and network included. Nested data and any documented file included. Empty extractions, duplicates, exclusions and failures without delivered rows are free. Invalid-syntax email, DNS NXDOMAIN and RDAP not-found diagnostic rows are billed where applicable. Stops at maxTotalChargeUsd (run option, not input); partial failures retain delivered row charges.
